'''2005 East Coast Open''' was a Star Wars CCG open tournament that [[Tim Simon]] announced for Saturday 2 April 2005 at Renaissance Games in Fallston, Maryland, with guaranteed cash prizes and the Players Committee's Ultimate Prize Package.<ref name="pcf-4100-56234">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=56234#56234 Big Open on the East Coast?], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 November 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227083348/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55975%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-4100-56761">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=56761#56761 Big Open on the East Coast?], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (21 November 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227083348/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55975%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]] (from the card pool legal on the announced date)
* '''Site:''' Renaissance Games, Fallston, Maryland<ref name="pcf-4100-56761" />
* '''Dates:''' 2 April 2005, 1 pm (announced)<ref name="pcf-4100-56761" /><ref name="pcf-4100-58427">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58427#58427 Big Open on the East Coast?], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 December 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227083348/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55975%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Organizer:''' [[Tim Simon]]<ref name="pcf-4100-55975">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55975#55975 Big Open on the East Coast?], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 November 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227083348/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55975%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Prizes:''' guaranteed cash prizes and the Ultimate Prize Package<ref name="pcf-4100-56761" />

== Organization ==

On 10 November 2004 Simon asked players whether they would come to a big open tournament in the Maryland and southern New Jersey area in late winter or early spring 2005, with prizes in the style of the Ultimate Prize Package.<ref name="pcf-4100-55975" /> Three days later he set the date as Saturday 2 April and promised at least one tournament, and perhaps a second, with large cash prizes as well as byes to the 2005 World Championship under the Ultimate Prize Package.<ref name="pcf-4100-56234" /> On 21 November he named Renaissance Games in Fallston as the site.<ref name="pcf-4100-56761" /> In December he set the start of the Open for 1 pm and asked whether players wanted side events such as [[Classic]] or "[[No Such Thing As Luck]]".<ref name="pcf-4100-58427" /> He explained No Such Thing As Luck as a format in which each round is two games: the players play once, then swap decks and play again.<ref name="pcf-4100-60063">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60063#60063 Big Open on the East Coast?], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227083348/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55975%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

In January 2005 Simon said he could count on at least about 15 players and was aiming for about 30.<ref name="pcf-4100-59824">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59824#59824 Big Open on the East Coast?], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227083348/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55975%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He posted three hotels in Edgewood and Joppa, Maryland, for travelling players,<ref name="pcf-4100-60158">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60158#60158 Big Open on the East Coast?], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227083348/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55975%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> asked about adding a sealed deck event,<ref name="pcf-4100-60316">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60316#60316 Big Open on the East Coast?], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050213134055/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=61478%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and reported that Renaissance Games had offered to hold a mini-tournament on the Friday night before the Open.<ref name="pcf-4100-60341">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60341#60341 Big Open on the East Coast?], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050213134055/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=61478%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
